item.title: Qatar mourns an Amiri Naval Forces member as Gulf condolences pour in
item.description:
The Ministry of Defence mourned Lance Corporal Ammar Yasser Arafat Mohammed of the Amiri Naval Forces, who was martyred while performing his military duty on Monday 23 November. GCC Secretary-General Jasem Albudaiwi offered his condolences to Qatar on Tuesday, and Bahrain and Kuwait expressed their solidarity with Doha.
Sources: Al Jazeera Net https://www.aljazeera.net/news/2026/11/23/%D9%88%D8%B2%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%81%D8%A7%D8%B9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%82%D8%B7%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D9%86%D8%B9%D9%89-%D8%A3%D8%AD%D8%AF-%D9%85%D9%86%D8%AA%D8%B3%D8%A8%D9%8A · Al Sharq https://al-sharq.com/article/24/11/2026/مجلس-التعاون-يعزي-قطر-إثر-استشهاد-أحد-منتسبي-القوات-البحرية-الأميرية · Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/24/gcc-secretary-general-offers-condolences-to-qatar-over-navy-members-martyrdom · Al Raya (QNA) https://www.raya.com/2026/11/24/البحرين-تعزي-قطر-في-استشهاد-أحد-منتسبي-القوات-البحرية-الأميرية

item.title: Qatar condemns in the strongest terms the Houthi attack on a Riyadh tower
item.description:
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs on Tuesday condemned the Houthi attack on a tower in Riyadh’s Financial Center, calling it a reprehensible act of aggression, a blatant disregard for civilian lives and a flagrant violation of Saudi sovereignty and international law. It said Saudi Arabia’s security is an integral part of Qatar’s security and of the GCC collective security system.
Sources: Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/24/qatar-strongly-condemns-houthi-attack-on-riyadh-financial-center-tower · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/24/11/2026/qatar-strongly-condemns-houthi-attack-on-financial-center-tower-in-riyadh · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/266207/latest-news/qatar-condemns-houthi-attack-on-riyadh-financial-center-tower

item.title: Qatar Stock Exchange index closes above 10,000, up 0.74%
item.description:
The Qatar Stock Exchange index closed Tuesday’s session up 73.72 points, or 0.74%, at 10,051.53. Volume reached 129.5 million shares worth QR482.9 million in 32,460 trades; 30 stocks rose and 18 fell, and market capitalisation climbed to QR613.1 billion from QR608.8 billion.
Sources: Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/24/qse-index-closes-higher · Al Sharq (QNA) https://al-sharq.com/article/24/11/2026/مؤشر-بورصة-قطر-يغلق-تداولاته-مرتفعا-81

item.title: Central bank issues QR5 billion in government Ijarah sukuk
item.description:
Qatar Central Bank on Tuesday issued QR5 billion of government Ijarah sukuk on behalf of the Ministry of Finance in two tranches: QR2.5 billion maturing on 16 January 2029 at a 5.65% yield and QR2.5 billion maturing on 19 August 2031 at 5.75%. Total bids reached QR10.2 billion, more than twice the amount offered.
Sources: Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/24/qatar-central-bank-issues-qr-5-billion-in-government-ljarah-sukuk · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/266204/latest-news/qatar-central-bank-issues-qr5-bn-in-government-ljarah-sukuk

item.title: Health ministry warns against ‘Cactus Pills’ slimming product containing sibutramine
item.description:
The Ministry of Public Health on Tuesday warned against a slimming product promoted on social media as Hoodia Gordonii, or ‘Cactus Pills’, after tests by its Drug Quality Control Laboratory confirmed it contains sibutramine. The ministry classified the product, which is not registered in Qatar, as falsified and is working with the authorities on legal action against violators.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/24/11/2026/qatar-health-ministry-detects-potentially-harmful-substance-in-cactus-pills · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/266202/latest-news/moph-warns-against-slimming-pills-containing-banned-substance-sibutramine

item.title: Ten-man Al Sadd lose 2-1 to Al Nassr in the AFC Champions League
item.description:
Al Sadd lost 2-1 to hosts Al Nassr in Riyadh on Tuesday evening in the league phase of the AFC Champions League Elite. Cristiano Ronaldo scored a 13th-minute penalty, Mohammed Waad equalised in the 22nd minute before being sent off in first-half stoppage time, and Joao Felix struck the winner with an overhead kick in the 52nd minute. Al Sadd remain on two points.
Sources: Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738947/sport/football/ · Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/24/x/7631476 · Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2535431

item.title: Eleven injured in Houthi attack on a Riyadh financial district tower
item.description:
Eleven people, including two Saudi citizens, four Egyptian, three Nepali and two Indian residents, were injured on Tuesday in a Houthi attack on a tower in Riyadh’s financial district, according to Saudi Civil Defence. Witnesses told AFP the capital’s tallest skyscraper, home to the Public Investment Fund, was hit for the second time in less than a week; the UAE condemned the attack.
Sources: Saudi Gazette https://saudigazette.com.sa/article/666501/saudi-arabia/coalition-riyadh-kafd-tower-targeted-in-terrorist-attack · News of Bahrain https://www.newsofbahrain.com/en/article/11-injured-in-attack-on-riyadh-financial-district-tower · Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/24/houthi-attack-on-riyadh-financial-center-tower-leaves-11-injured · Gulf News (AFP) https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/middle-east-conflict-us-investigates-iran-over-cyberattacks-on-50-ships-as-fresh-sanctions-target-irans-shadow-banking-network-1.500758688

item.title: Saudi Arabia approves 2027 budget with SR1.392 trillion spending and SR190.6bn deficit
item.description:
The Saudi Cabinet, chaired by Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman, on Tuesday approved the 2027 state budget with spending of SR1.392 trillion, projected revenue of SR1.201 trillion and an estimated deficit of about SR190.6 billion. Finance Minister Mohammed Al-Jadaan said non-oil activities recorded their highest contribution to GDP, at 57.7%.
Sources: Saudi Gazette https://saudigazette.com.sa/article/666497/saudi-arabia/saudi-arabia-unveils-2027-state-budget-with-sr1201-trillion-revenues-and-sr1392-trillion-expenditures · Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/24/saudi-cabinet-convenes-approves-2027-budget · News of Bahrain https://www.newsofbahrain.com/en/article/saudi-arabia-targets-stronger-growth-with-2027-budget · Saudi Gazette https://saudigazette.com.sa/article/666503/saudi-arabia/al-jadaan-non-oil-activities-record-highest-contribution-to-gdp-at-577percent

item.title: IRGC says a fourth tanker and a container ship hit mines near Hormuz
item.description:
The IRGC Navy said on Tuesday that a fourth oil tanker exploded and caught fire after striking a mine east of the Strait of Hormuz, following its announcement that three tankers had been hit. IRNA quoted the Guards as saying a container ship stopped after hitting a mine while sailing an “unauthorised” route, as Tehran warned ships against using unapproved lanes.
Sources: Saudi Gazette https://saudigazette.com.sa/article/666499/world/iran-says-four-oil-tankers-caught-fire-after-hitting-mines-in-strait-of-hormuz · Sada El Balad (Reuters) https://www.elbalad.news/7193386 · Gulf News (AFP) https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/middle-east-conflict-us-investigates-iran-over-cyberattacks-on-50-ships-as-fresh-sanctions-target-irans-shadow-banking-network-1.500758688

item.title: Yemeni army says Houthis are 60 kilometres from Aden
item.description:
Yemeni armed forces spokesman Colonel Majid al-Nuzaili said on Tuesday that Houthi fighters are about 60 kilometres from Aden, the temporary capital of the internationally recognised government, and are “ready to attack”. He said government forces have prepared their defences and will not allow armed factions to take the city.
Sources: Gulf News (AFP) https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/middle-east-conflict-us-investigates-iran-over-cyberattacks-on-50-ships-as-fresh-sanctions-target-irans-shadow-banking-network-1.500758688 · Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7193422

item.title: Ras Al Khaimah crash death toll rises to 13, with 14 injured
item.description:
The toll from a collision between a passenger bus and a parked truck on Al Watan Road in Ras Al Khaimah early on Tuesday rose to 13 dead and 14 injured after two passengers died of their wounds, Ras Al Khaimah Police said. The bus was carrying 41 people, most returning to the UAE after a visa-change trip, and the Indian Consulate confirmed Indians were among the victims.
Sources: News of Bahrain https://www.newsofbahrain.com/en/article/ras-al-khaimah-bus-truck-collision-kills-13-injures-14 · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/uae/ras-al-khaimah-bus-truck-crash-victims-were-returning-from-oman-to-uae-after-visa-change-says-travel-agency-1.500759684

item.title: Egypt and Sudan reject any unilateral measures in the Eastern Nile basin
item.description:
President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi on Tuesday received Sudan’s transitional Prime Minister Kamil Idris, and a joint statement at the end of his visit stressed protecting both countries’ water rights under the 1959 agreement and rejected any unilateral measures in the Eastern Nile basin. Cairo reaffirmed its support for Sudan’s unity and national institutions and its rejection of any parallel entities or their recognition.
Sources: Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_egypt/details/2026/11/24/3083848 · Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/24/egyptian-president-sudanese-pm-discuss-efforts-to-end-sudan-war

item.title: Ten killed as minibus and truck collide on the Abu Simbel road
item.description:
Ten people were killed and others, including children, injured when a minibus collided with a truck near kilometre 110 of the Abu Simbel tourist road south of Aswan on Tuesday. The injured were taken to Al-Sadaqa Hospital in Aswan; the victims came from seven governorates, including Assiut, Qalyubia and Luxor.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/24/x/7631457 · Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2535403 · Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7193377

item.title: Dutch embassy in Cairo closes to the public until further notice
item.description:
The Dutch embassy in Cairo announced on Tuesday that its building is closed to the public until further notice as a precaution, a decision by the Dutch foreign ministry in light of demonstrations held outside the embassy. It said the closure does not affect VFS Global services in Cairo and that people with appointments will be contacted to reschedule.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/24/x/7631214 · Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7193078

item.title: Egypt’s 21-carat gold falls to EGP5,640 as global prices slide
item.description:
The price of 21-carat gold in Egypt fell to EGP5,640 a gram in Tuesday evening trading, with 24-carat at EGP6,445 and the gold pound at EGP45,120. The decline came as the global ounce dropped 1.8% to below $3,600, despite a weaker US dollar.
Sources: Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_economy/details/2026/11/24/3083885 · Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7193148

item.title: Minister plans 8 million cubic metres of daily desalination from reactor cooling
item.description:
Electricity and Renewable Energy Minister Mahmoud Esmat said on Tuesday evening that the ministry is working to use cooling water from nuclear reactor condensers to run seawater desalination plants, cutting the power consumed in desalination. He said the plan targets about 8 million cubic metres a day of desalinated water for land reclamation projects.
Sources: Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_egypt/details/2026/11/24/3084029 · Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7193433

item.title: CAS reinstates Senegal as 2025 Africa Cup of Nations champions
item.description:
The Court of Arbitration for Sport unanimously ruled on Tuesday to reinstate Senegal as 2025 Africa Cup of Nations champions, overturning the CAF Appeal Board’s 17 March decision to award the title to Morocco. Senegal had won the Rabat final 1-0 after extra time on 18 January, after their players walked off in protest at a penalty.
Sources: Gulf Times (AFP) https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738925/sport/football/senegal-reinstated-as-2025-africa-cup-of-nations-winners · Al Sharq https://al-sharq.com/article/24/11/2026/محكمة-التحكيم-الرياضية-تعيد-لقب-كأس-أمم-إفريقيا-2025-إلى-المنتخب-السنغالي · Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/24/x/7631145

item.title: Israeli strike kills Hamas internal security chief in Gaza
item.description:
An Israeli airstrike west of Gaza City on Tuesday killed Hamas internal security director Brigadier General Naim Abu Nahal, in a series of strikes that killed seven people despite the ceasefire, Palestinian officials and the Israeli military said. Gaza’s interior ministry confirmed his death, and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu praised the operation.
Sources: Saudi Gazette https://saudigazette.com.sa/article/666495/world/israeli-air-strike-kills-hamas-internal-security-chief-in-gaza · Gulf News (AFP) https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/middle-east-conflict-us-investigates-iran-over-cyberattacks-on-50-ships-as-fresh-sanctions-target-irans-shadow-banking-network-1.500758688

item.title: Russian strike on Zaporizhzhia kills two and injures more than 40
item.description:
Two people were killed and 44 injured, including an infant and three children, in a Russian air attack on the Ukrainian city of Zaporizhzhia, Regional Governor Mykhailo Semikin said. The attack destroyed a house and partly destroyed a five-storey building, a day after Kyiv said its drones sank a Russian warship in a Libyan port.
Sources: Saudi Gazette https://saudigazette.com.sa/article/666498/world/ukraine-says-2-killed-over-40-wounded-in-russian-air-strike-on-zaporizhzhia · News of Bahrain https://www.newsofbahrain.com/en/article/russian-strike-kills-two-injures-40-in-ukraines-zaporizhzhia

item.title: Washington weighs targeting senior Iranian leaders to end the war
item.description:
Officials in President Donald Trump’s administration are debating whether to target and kill senior Iranian leaders to remove hardliners from power, NBC reported. Supporters say the move would pressure Tehran to end the war, while opponents warn it could strengthen hardliners and undermine any future negotiations.
Sources: Gulf News (AFP) https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/middle-east-conflict-us-investigates-iran-over-cyberattacks-on-50-ships-as-fresh-sanctions-target-irans-shadow-banking-network-1.500758688 · Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_publicaffairs/details/2026/11/24/3084007

item.title: Five Turkish servicemen killed in helicopter crash on training mission
item.description:
Turkey’s Defence Ministry said on Tuesday that five Air Force personnel were killed when an AS-532 military helicopter crashed after taking off from Eskisehir province on a training mission. The ministry said search and rescue teams reached the wreckage.
Sources: Al Sharq (QNA) https://al-sharq.com/article/24/11/2026/وزارة-الدفاع-التركية-تعلن-تحطم-مروحية-عسكرية-خلال-مهمة-تدريبية · Youm7 (Anadolu) https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/24/x/7631434

item.title: Gold falls 1.8% to $3,566 on rate-hike expectations
item.description:
Spot gold fell 1.8% to $3,566.45 an ounce on Tuesday after touching $3,558.69, pressured by hawkish signals from Federal Reserve officials and rising expectations of a December rate hike. Silver dropped 5% to $40.90 and platinum 3.9% to $1,273.78.
Sources: Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/24/gold-price-down-to-usd-356645ounce · Cairo 24 (Reuters) https://www.cairo24.com/2535427
